target_claim: If an input vertex p lies inside the diametral circle on segment ab, then angle apb is less than π/2.
source_quote:
If an input vertex $p$
lies inside the diametral circle on line segment $ab$,
the perpendicular projection of $p$ on the line joining
$a$ and $b$ lies on the line segment joining $a$ and $b$.
Let the point of projection be $m$.  Further,
$\angle apb < \pi/2$.
